test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Tim joined the family business as he failed in his final degree examination. Seeing the growth of the family business now, it seems like Tim’s earlier failure was __a blessing in disguise.__

options.text: Something good that isn't recognised at first

solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"blessing in disguise"** means something that initially seems bad or unfortunate but eventually turns out to be beneficial. (छलावा में वरदान)
 
 
• **Example: **Losing that job was a blessing in disguise because it pushed him to start his own successful business.
 
 
 
• **"Blessing in disguise"** refers to an apparent misfortune that eventually results in something good. (छलावा में वरदान)
